Small talk is a short, easy conversation about simple topics. People make small talk with neighbors, classmates, and even strangers at a bus stop.
Good topics are the weather, the weekend, food, and hobbies. It is better not to ask about money or age at first.
A good conversation is like a game of catch. You throw a question, and the other person throws one back.
Listen carefully, nod, and ask a follow-up question. For example, if someone says, "I like hiking," you can ask, "Where do you usually go?"
